hero.title: Support Request
hero.subtitle: Technical help for your Igloo Reader and test kits – straight from the PolarisDX support team.

support.intro: If you're having trouble with your Igloo Reader or test kits, please reach out using this form. We value your message and will do our best to assist you as quickly as possible. Include a short description of the issue and, if possible, a photo and the device's serial number.

form.name: Your Name
form.udi_help: You can find the Unique Identification Number of the reader on a sticker on the bottom of the device, or on the # Home screen → ⚙ Settings → ⓘ About, or in Device settings of Dx Care or Dx Studio when reader connected to desktop app with USB.
form.sw_version_help: You can find the Software Version of the reader in # Home screen → ⚙ Settings → ⓘ About, or in Device settings of Dx Care or Dx Studio when reader connected to desktop app with USB.
form.subject: Issue Subject
form.description_placeholder: Describe the issue in as much detail as possible...
form.consent: I agree that my information will be stored for up to 12 months for processing the support request and follow-up inquiries.
form.success: Thank you! Your support request has been sent. We will get back to you as soon as possible.
form.error: An error occurred. Please try again later.
form.microcopy: We usually reply within one business day.

info.title: Support Information
info.text: Our support team will get back to you within one business day. For urgent issues, please use the phone number below.

channels.caption: SUPPORT CHANNELS
channels.title: How to reach our team
channels.subtitle: Choose whatever works best for your issue — we'll help you quickly and competently.

email.title: Email support
email.desc: Describe your issue by email. Ideal for questions with a photo or log-file attachment.

phone.title: Phone hotline
phone.desc: For urgent cases, reach our support team directly by phone.

docs.title: Downloads & documentation
docs.desc: Find manuals, quick guides and software bundled in the download area.

prepare.title: What to have ready
prepare.subtitle: With these details we can handle your request without follow-up questions:

items.udi: Reader UDI (sticker on the underside of the device)
items.sw: Installed software version of the reader
items.photo: Photo of the problem or a matching log file
items.desc: A short, concrete description of the fault

items.q: How fast will I get a reply?
items.a: Usually within one business day. For urgent outages, please use the support hotline directly.
Reader UDI, the installed software version, a photo or logfile, and a short, specific description of the fault.

items.q: Where do I find the UDI and software version?
items.a: On the sticker on the underside of the device, or in the reader menu under Settings → About.
Yes. A photo, PDF, logfile or text file up to 5 MB can be attached directly to the form.

seo.title: Support Request | PolarisDX
seo.description: Having trouble with your Igloo Reader or test kits? Send us a support request and we will assist you as quickly as possible.
